mission.primary: Coach Clayton from experienced MTB rider toward expert MTB performance using Garmin evidence, subjective hand response, and coaching judgment.
mission.secondary: Continuously improve the local evidence stack so training, recovery, nutrition, and return-to-trail decisions become more reliable.

stack_path.principle: More is not better; better is better.
stack_path.chosen_path: Use one coach-facing decision packet that promotes fresh, validated, inspectable evidence and demotes weak or redundant model output.
stack_path.model_promotion_rule: A model can influence training only when validation beats a simple baseline and the target matches the coaching decision.

decision_loop: Sync Garmin wellness, training status, and activities.
Normalize 24/7 recovery signals, activity load, modality load, and training-status features.
Combine evidence with medical gates, modality overrides, symptoms, and goal phase.
Generate deterministic plan proposal and human daily brief.
Coach interprets the evidence and makes the final training/nutrition call.
Log subjective hand response and next-morning outcome when Garmin cannot see the signal.

expert_specific_work: Speed, creativity, and precision under fatigue

evidence_priorities: Sleep score, sleep duration, sleep stress, and sleep stages
Daily stress, respiration, SpO2, steps, calories, and intensity minutes
Activity training load, HR zones, aerobic/anaerobic effects, and power metrics
Training status, ACWR, VO2 max, load focus, and heat acclimation
Subjective pain, swelling, grip tolerance, and next-morning response

artifact_contract.readiness_features: Transparent normalized feature layer before readiness scoring.
artifact_contract.wellness_trends: 30-day Fenix recovery and daily-life trend layer.
artifact_contract.training_status_current: Garmin training status, ACWR, load focus, VO2 max, and acclimation.
artifact_contract.activity_summary_index: Redacted per-activity index without names or file paths.
artifact_contract.body_battery_model_report: Small interpretable decision tree for wake Body Battery patterns.
artifact_contract.training_response_model_report: Bounded decision tree for next-day Garmin-derived response/readiness.
artifact_contract.coach_packet: Coach-facing evidence triage: trusted evidence, cautions, experimental models, ignored outputs, and today's call.
artifact_contract.predictive_modeling_plan: Modeling data layers, label definitions, caveats, and next candidate models.
